_about: Measure the CENTRING points the textbooks name, on each model, for the Trainer. Rest-frame cm from the volume centre.

mcp3Joint.how: the joint space along the 3rd ray: the deepest dip in bone between the metacarpal head and the proximal phalanx
mcp3Joint.guide: PA and PA oblique hand: CR perpendicular to the 3rd MCP joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

mcp2Joint.how: the joint space along the 2nd ray: the deepest dip in bone between the metacarpal head and the proximal phalanx
mcp2Joint.guide: Lateral hand: CR perpendicular to the 2nd MCP joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

pip2Joint.how: the index finger's PIP joint space: the phalangeal head's centre (data/joints.json pip2) carried 0.95 cm, half its depth, along the finger
pip2Joint.guide: PA and lateral finger: CR perpendicular to the PIP joint of the affected digit (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

midcarpal.how: the middle of the carpus (the midcarpal landmark: 2 cm proximal of the carpometacarpal level), on the line of the 3rd metacarpal (the capitate)
midcarpal.guide: PA, PA oblique and lateral wrist: CR perpendicular to the midcarpal area (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

mc3Base.how: the 3rd metacarpal at the carpometacarpal level: bone within 0.7 cm of the 3rd ray
mc3Base.guide: 3rd metacarpal axis (base to MCP joint), for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

radiusDistal.how: the centroid of the radius (the larger forearm bone) 2 cm proximal of the radiocarpal joint
radiusDistal.guide: distal radius axis, for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

radiusProx.how: the centroid of the radius (the larger forearm bone) 5 cm proximal of the radiocarpal joint
radiusProx.guide: distal radius axis, for the hand/wrist alignment criterion

radiocarpal.how: the radiocarpal joint (2.2 cm proximal of the midcarpal landmark), midway between the radial and ulnar styloids
radiocarpal.guide: PA, PA oblique and lateral wrist: CR perpendicular to the radiocarpal joint, midway between the styloids (the department's routine; Bontrager gives the midcarpal area)

scaphoid.how: the radial-most 1.5 cm of carpal bone 1 cm distal to the radiocarpal joint: the scaphoid
scaphoid.guide: PA axial scaphoid: CR 10-15 degrees proximally, toward the elbow, to the scaphoid, hand in ulnar deviation (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

intermalleolar.how: midway between the measured medial and lateral malleoli
intermalleolar.guide: AP, AP mortise and AP oblique ankle: CR perpendicular to a point midway between the malleoli (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

medialMalleolus.guide: Lateral (mediolateral) ankle: CR perpendicular to the medial malleolus (Bontrager)

mt3Base.how: the middle third of the foot bone 43-51 % of the way from the ankle to the tip of the toes (19.2 cm): the base of the 3rd metatarsal
mt3Base.guide: AP foot: CR 10 degrees toward the heel to the base of the 3rd metatarsal; AP medial oblique foot: CR perpendicular to the base of the 3rd metatarsal (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

medialCuneiform.how: the base of the 3rd metatarsal less 2 cm along the foot (toward the heel): the cuneiforms
medialCuneiform.guide: Lateral (mediolateral) foot: CR perpendicular to the medial cuneiform, at the level of the base of the 3rd metatarsal (Bontrager)

mtp3Joint.how: the gap along the 3rd ray between the metatarsal head and the proximal phalanx, 81 % of the way to the tip of the toes
mtp3Joint.guide: AP toes: CR 10-15 degrees toward the heel to the 3rd MTP joint (all toes); AP oblique toes: CR perpendicular to it (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

calcaneus.how: the bone behind the ankle and below the medial malleolus, its centroid: the body of the calcaneus
calcaneus.guide: Lateral calcaneus: CR perpendicular to a point 2.5 cm inferior to the medial malleolus (the calcaneal body); axial (plantodorsal) calcaneus: CR 40 degrees cephalad to the long axis of the foot (Bontrager)

legMid.how: midway between the knee joint and the tibiotalar joint (-5.3 / -39.1), the centre of the tibia and fibula's section there
legMid.guide: AP, AP obliques and lateral tibia/fibula: CR perpendicular to the mid-point of the leg, both joints on the receptor (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

patellofemoral.how: the patellofemoral joint: 1.45 cm behind the most anterior bone of the patella (data/palpation.json patella), its articular surface; set on the Settegast film, where 2.5 cm put the ray 2 cm into the trochlea
patellofemoral.guide: Tangential (skyline, Settegast) patella: CR to the patellofemoral joint space (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

elbowJoint.how: the elbow joint: 1.5 cm distal of the midpoint of the measured epicondyles
elbowJoint.guide: AP, AP obliques and lateral elbow: CR perpendicular to the mid elbow joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

glenohumeral.how: the glenohumeral joint line: from the centre of the humeral head (data/joints.json shoulder) one head radius (2.3 cm) along the normal of the glenoid face, the plane fitted to the scapula within 1.3 cm of the head (tools/measure_joints.py)
glenohumeral.guide: Inferosuperior and superoinferior axial shoulder: CR to the glenohumeral joint (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C4.how: the body of C4, from the vertebra labels of the CT (s1082)
C4.guide: AP axial cervical: CR 15-20 degrees cephalad to C4, the lower margin of the thyroid cartilage; lateral cervical: CR to C4; AP (posterior) obliques: CR 15-20 degrees cephalad to C4 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C1C2.how: midway between the bodies of C1 and C2: the dens and the atlas
C1C2.guide: AP open mouth (C1-C2): CR perpendicular through the centre of the open mouth, to C1-C2 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C7T1.how: midway between the bodies of C7 and T1: the cervicothoracic junction
C7T1.guide: Swimmers lateral (cervicothoracic): CR to C7-T1, about 2.5 cm above the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

clavicleR.how: the right clavicle half way along it (9.5 cm right of the midline): the centroid of the topmost bone in front of the vertebral bodies (top at z -12.2)
clavicleR.guide: AP and AP axial clavicle: CR to the mid-clavicle (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

eam.how: midway between the ear canals: the air each side enclosed by tissue within 1.2 cm, beside and above the mastoid tip
eam.guide: Lateral soft-tissue neck (adenoids): CR to the EAM, the nasopharynx in the field (Radiopaedia)

nasion.how: the nasion: on the midline front profile 12 mm above the orbits' openings
nasion.guide: PA skull: CR perpendicular to the IR, OML perpendicular, exiting the nasion; PA axial (Caldwell): CR 15 degrees caudad to the OML, exiting the nasion; AP skull: CR perpendicular, entering the nasion (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

acanthion.how: the acanthion: the midline's most anterior bone 3.5-6.5 cm below the nasion
acanthion.guide: Parietoacanthial (Waters): OML 37 degrees to the IR (the mentomeatal line perpendicular), CR perpendicular, exiting the acanthion (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

eam.guide: AP axial (Towne): CR 30 degrees caudad to the OML, through the level of the EAMs and the foramen magnum, entering about 6 cm above the glabella (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

latSkull.how: the middle of the head: halfway between the glabella and the inion, and between the vertex and the mandible's lowest bone, on the midline
latSkull.guide: Lateral skull: CR perpendicular to the middle of the head, about 2 cm in front of the EAM, so the vertex, frontal bone, occiput and mandible are all on the film (Bontrager centres the cranium alone 5 cm (2 in) above the EAM); IOML parallel to the transverse axis of the IR (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

zygoma.how: midway between the orbits' openings (the outer canthi) and the ear canals
zygoma.guide: Lateral facial bones and sinuses: CR perpendicular to the zygoma, midway between the outer canthus and the EAM (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7.how: T7: the centre of the lung fields (z -11.2 to 16.0), on the midsagittal plane, at the midcoronal plane; 9 cm below the jugular notch gives 7.8
T7.guide: PA chest: CR to the midsagittal plane at T7, the centre of the lung fields; AP thoracic spine: CR to T7, 8-10 cm below the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7mc.how: T7 (as above) on the midcoronal plane: halfway between the front and back of the body at the midline
T7mc.guide: Lateral chest: CR to the midcoronal plane at T7 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

ribsR.how: midway between the midsagittal plane and the right lateral margin of the ribs (13.4 cm) at T7, on the midcoronal plane
ribsR.guide: Ribs above the diaphragm, PA and AP obliques: CR midway between the midsagittal plane and the lateral margin of the affected side, at T7 (Bontrager)

T7.how: T7: the centre of the lung fields (z 8.4 to 40.4), on the midsagittal plane, at the depth of the vertebral bodies; 9 cm below the jugular notch gives 26.6
T7.guide: PA chest: CR to the midsagittal plane at T7, the centre of the lung fields; AP thoracic spine: CR to T7, 8-10 cm below the jugular notch (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7mc.how: T7 (as above) on the midcoronal plane: halfway between the front and back of the body at the midline
T7mc.guide: Lateral chest: CR to the midcoronal plane at T7 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crest.how: the level of the iliac crests (mean of the two measured crests), midsagittal, at the depth of the vertebral bodies
crest.guide: AP lumbar spine (35 x 43 cm): CR to the level of the iliac crest, L4-L5 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crestMc.how: the level of the iliac crests on the midcoronal plane
crestMc.guide: Lateral lumbar spine (35 x 43 cm): CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred to the midcoronal plane (Bontrager)

crestCol.how: the level of the iliac crests (L4-L5), midsagittal, at the middle of the depth of the vertebral column from z -8.3 to 9.2: front of the bodies y -1.8, spinous tips y -12.0 (largest vertebra in a 6 cm slab, every 1 cm)
crestCol.guide: Lateral lumbar spine: CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred on the vertebral column (the midcoronal plane on an average adult); collimate to about 20 cm wide, 1" beyond the bodies and spinous processes (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7col.how: T7 (the centre of the lung fields), midsagittal, at the middle of the depth of the vertebral column from z 11.4 to 33.9: front of the bodies y -3.4, spinous tips y -13.2 (largest vertebra in a 6 cm slab, every 1 cm)
T7col.guide: Lateral thoracic spine: CR to T7, centred on the vertebral column; collimate long and narrow to the column (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

sacrum.how: the sacrum: the centroid of the bone within 4 cm of the midline from S1 (z -8.8, 5 cm below the crests) to the coccyx (3.5 cm above its tip)
sacrum.guide: AP axial sacrum: CR 15 degrees cephalad, entering 5 cm superior to the symphysis pubis; lateral sacrum: CR to the sacrum, 8-10 cm posterior to the ASIS (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

coccyx.how: the coccyx: the centroid of the midline bone behind the pelvis in the 3.5 cm above its tip (z -21.8)
coccyx.guide: AP axial coccyx: CR 10 degrees caudad, entering 5 cm superior to the symphysis pubis (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

acetabula.how: midway between the two femoral heads (data/landmarks.json femoralHeadL/R, z -19.1 and -19.7), on the midsagittal plane
acetabula.guide: Judet obliques: CR to the acetabula, about 5 cm distal to the ASIS, both hips and the proximal femurs on the film (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

femoralNeckR.how: the right femoral neck: 45 % of the way from the femoral head's centre (data/landmarks.json femoralHeadR) to the greater trochanter (data/palpation.json trochanterR)
femoralNeckR.guide: AP hip: CR perpendicular to the femoral neck, 2.5-5 cm distal to the midpoint of the ASIS-symphysis line (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

femoralNeckL.how: the left femoral neck: 45 % of the way from the femoral head's centre (data/landmarks.json femoralHeadL) to the greater trochanter (data/palpation.json trochanterL)
femoralNeckL.guide: AP hip: CR perpendicular to the femoral neck, 2.5-5 cm distal to the midpoint of the ASIS-symphysis line (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7.how: T7: the centre of the lung fields (lung labels z 29.6 to 44.6), on the midsagittal plane at the depth of the vertebral bodies; the jugular notch is 6.0 cm above it
T7.guide: PA/AP chest: CR to the midsagittal plane at T7, the centre of the lung fields; on a child the field is collimated to the lungs (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7mc.how: T7 (as above) on the midcoronal plane: halfway between the front and back of the body at the midline
T7mc.guide: Lateral chest: CR to the midcoronal plane at T7 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crest.how: the level of the iliac crests, midsagittal, at the depth of the vertebral bodies
crest.guide: AP abdomen / lumbar spine: CR to the level of the iliac crest, L4-L5 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

crestMc.how: the level of the iliac crests on the midcoronal plane
crestMc.guide: Lateral lumbar spine: CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred to the midcoronal plane (Bontrager)

crestCol.how: the level of the iliac crests on the middle of the lumbar column's depth (front of the bodies y -2.3, spinous tips 4.0, volume frame)
crestCol.guide: Lateral lumbar spine: CR to the level of the iliac crest (L4-L5), centred on the vertebral column (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

T7col.how: T7 on the middle of the thoracic column's depth (T3-T12)
T7col.guide: Lateral thoracic spine: CR to T7, centred on the vertebral column (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C4.how: the body of C4 (the head donor's labels, on the model)
C4.guide: AP axial cervical: CR 15-20 degrees cephalad to C4; lateral cervical: CR to C4 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C1C2.how: midway between the bodies of C1 and C2
C1C2.guide: AP open mouth (C1-C2): CR through the centre of the open mouth, to C1-C2 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

C7T1.how: midway between the bodies of C7 and T1 (the seam of the graft: the head donor's C7 on the child's T1)
C7T1.guide: Swimmers lateral: CR to C7-T1 (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

skull.how: the middle of the skull label: halfway between the vertex (70.0) and the mandible (51.4), and between its front and back, on the cranium's midline
skull.guide: AP / lateral skull: CR to the middle of the head, so the whole skull, vertex to mandible, is on the film (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)

pelvis.how: midway between the ASIS (5.3 / 5.6) and the pubic symphysis (-2.8)
pelvis.guide: AP pelvis: CR midway between the ASIS and the symphysis (Bontrager; Radiopaedia)
